San Frediano (Oltrarno) — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

San Frediano, in the Oltrarno, has become an increasingly fashionable nightlife district ('la notte più cool'), but this popularity has come with genuine resident complaints: residents wrote directly to the police chief and Prefect saying they no longer felt safe, citing movida-related disorder and disturbances. The police have run dedicated 'movida sicura' checks in the wider Oltrarno/San Niccolò area in response. Daytime, the area is a normal, popular residential and artisan-shop district. Sources checked: La Nazione, San Frediano residents' letter to police chief and Prefect over safety concerns; La Nazione, 'San Frediano, la notte è più cool. Ma l'Oltrarno è anche degli invisibili'.
